messages:
anya: Quick update 1 privacy has signed off on the offboarding appendix. Need final manager checklist, opt-in copy, and tracking approach.

julie: I can draft the handbook paragraph + a short FAQ entry.

olivia: Ops note: exports should snapshot these fields before deprovision: employee_id,name,email,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial.

sam: Managers need a recorded 10-12min walkthrough and a 1-click acknowledgement within 7 days of any exit.

ken: Proposed opt-in checkbox text: "I consent to temporary retention of account logs and backups for security investigations (up to 12 months)."

anya: Timeline: publish handbook update tomorrow AM, post 2-slide checklist and tracker, record manager video and require ack. Olivia will run exports 24h before deprovision.

julie: Draft handbook blurb: "On separation, Redwood removes personal account data within 30 days unless a legal hold or security investigation requires retention. Backups/logs may be retained up to 12 months for investigatory purposes; employees can opt in to short-term investigatory retention via e-sign. Managers will receive a checklist and must complete the microtraining."

olivia: CLI example for infra to snapshot offboard data:
```
# generate offboard snapshot for user 8032
redwood-admin export --user 8032 --fields employee_id,name,email,manager,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-8032.csv
```

hr-bot: Reminder created 1 publish appendix to #people-ops-docs and schedule manager recording for 2026-06-02 09:30 PT.

sam: Tracking schema: columns -> manager,employee_id,opt_in(Y/N),training_ack(Y/N),ack_ts. Want automatic ingestion from the 1-click ack.

ya: I'll post the draft + tracker link and the e-sign form id OFF-2026-09 in #people-ops-docs for review. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
